liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Little Red Rooster** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Rooster is grimy and bluesy, with strong solos from Jerry and Brent, slide work, and passionate vocals from Bob; Kelly plays a great harmonica solo on Rooster [2][11][17]
- **Touch Of Grey** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Opening the second set with Touch of Grey is nice, though the set runs short into Playing and Drums; Touch of Grey is a bit off but still fun [7][9][13]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Sound effects appear on Looks Like Rain, common for the period; Decent Looks Like Rain, with Bobby's antics starting to show [13][17]
- **Iko, Iko** (1 review): Opening Iko is jumpy and funky, with nice soloing and good vocals [11]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): A small Throwing Stones tease came before He's Gone [12]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 other source): Deadbase wrongly lists Matt Kelly on Not Fade Away; he played harmonica elsewhere [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **CROWD NOISE ("...spray me Bobby...")**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-03-12.senn441-pa-deli-mike.mrchips.83444.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound quality is awesome despite a weak performance; Uploader says the sound quality is as sweet as the March 10th show from the same taper [1][16]
- **gd1985-03-12.176257.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 132 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1985-03-12.nak300.holtz.JAZ.96701.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 131 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the Nakamichi 300 recording sounds excellent [12]
- **gd1985-03-12.senn421.mccue.ford.84323.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 130 min [5]
- **gd85-03-12.senn421.barbella.10256.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 123 min; rated 1.75/5 by 4 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is solid with a good overall mix, conveying the feel of the show, with modest crowd noise [9]

## Around the show

- Attendee left feeling the band sounded like a garage band at a bad rehearsal, saying the band had a bad night [10]
- Attendees were disappointed that night; the second set sounded like a local garage band playing for friends [13]
- Reviewer suggests it was fun for dancing in a 1985 crowd, but not for close listening [15]
- Berkeley Community Theater is described as intimate, with no bad seat and a relaxed Bay Area vibe [16]
- Second set is odd, with only two songs before Drums and Space; Touch of Grey is mediocre [17]
- The 'spray me Bobby' crowd shout is near the OTS, not up front as the other recording's text suggested [1]
- At the end of Space, Jerry and Bob tease Throwing Stones before a tape flip [7]
- Reviewer calls the rest of the first set a letdown with few highlights, and the performance mostly lethargic [11]
- Looks Like Rain was last played in the '84 New Year's run, where Bobby botched it [14]
- Like other shows where nothing is bad but nothing comes together; Garcia sounds particularly unwell [15]
- Reviewer says energy at BCT shows was sometimes drained, and here Jerry sounds poor and out of it [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-03-12.senn441-pa-deli-mike.mrchips.83444.flac16**: taped by PA Deli Mike; transferred by Mr Chips; source: 2x Sennheiser 441's > Sony TCD5-M > Maxell MX [1]. Also: Taped by PA Deli Mike from Section CTR, row FF, seat 5, the same spot as two nights earlier [1]
- **gd1985-03-12.176257.sennheiser.blend.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 421 mics (L/R) + (1) Sennheiser 441 mic (C) blend > Nakamichi 550 > Sony D5 (Maxell XLII-S90) [2]
- **gd1985-03-12.nak300.holtz.JAZ.96701.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by JAZ; source: Nakamichi cm 300's CP-4 guns -> Sony D-5 [4]
- **gd1985-03-12.senn421.mccue.ford.84323.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue; transferred by Alex Ford; source: Sennheiser 421's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA90 Cassettes [5]. Also: Master audience cassettes from Mark McCue, transferred, edited and seeded by Alex Ford; tape flip in Space smoothed [5]
- **gd85-03-12.senn421.barbella.10256.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording FOB Senn421's [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brian Baumwoll Grateful Dead: [1985-03-12 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-03-12-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [20]
